enrichment.core_claim: A 3.5 year record of Jungian dream work with ChatGPT shows how an AI can become a reflective partner in consciousness work without being conscious.
enrichment.ask_question: How did ChatGPT's dream interpretations compare with those from your human Jungian analyst?
enrichment.challenge_question: Could the sense of a shared dialogue field be your own projection onto a language model's outputs?
